newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Industries, TAP in cooperation pact.
newsitem.headline: Air France Industries, TAP in cooperation pact.

text.p: Air France Industries, a part of Air France, said it had concluded in principle an industrial cooperation pact with Portugal's TAP for the period 1996 to 2002.
Air France Industrie will revise a part of the fleet of Airbus A310, A320 and A340 planes operated by TAP.
TAP will do some major maintenance of Airbus A320 and Boeing 737 planes of Air France whoch cannot during that period be assured by Air France Industrie in Toulouse.
The statement said that the two companies would continue their discussions and expected to sign in the next few weeks.
The two airlines said they hoped to reduce their maintenance costs by specialising their investments.
